result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would help people better understand each other—not just intellectually, but emotionally and culturally. So much of the world’s tension, conflict, and loneliness stems from misunderstanding, fear of the unfamiliar, and a lack of deep empathy.  

If everyone could truly see through another’s eyes—even for a moment—it would soften judgments, build trust, and make it easier to collaborate on the big challenges we all face, like climate change, inequality, and peace.  

It’s not about making everyone the same, but about making difference something we explore with curiosity rather than defend against. That’s the change I’d want to ripple out.  

And if that sounds idealistic—that’s because it is. But ideals are what we reach for when we imagine better days.
